techniques.name: Promise line built word by word with a tinted arrival and a corner-dot frame
techniques.description: On #FEFEFE, one centred line in semibold sans (OCR line box 8.8% of frame height, 77.5% of width when complete). A word appears whole about every 10 frames (F0, F9, F19, F29, F40); each enters pale lilac (#B873B3), turns raspberry (#B73A69) on the next frame, then teal (#0A7F6F), and settles to ink #030303 about 5 frames after it appeared (F9-F14). The line recentres as each word lands (box centre x 0.505, 0.494, 0.504). Four small dots hover about 4% outside the text box and spread to its new corners over about 5-8 frames after each word. At F54-F59 the gap between the two phrases opens by about 5% of frame width; hard cut at F60.
techniques.routeReason: Pure type on a flat ground, revised with the copy. The library block `type-sentence-build` builds a sentence word by word on a light ground but has no tint-settle per word or corner-dot frame; `track`, `stagger` and `intentCurves.settle` cover the timing. What is missing is the per-word tint and the selection frame.

techniques.name: Black card on the incoming plate collapses into the next element's underline
techniques.description: Hard cut at F60 to a photographic plate covered by a soft-edged black rounded card about 92% wide and 85% high. It shrinks over 12 frames toward (0.45, 0.43), ease-out (frame difference 41, 33, 24, 16, 11, 6, 3, 1.7), flattening into a thin bar that becomes the white selection underline below the first icon of a floating dock; the icons fade in around it from F70.
techniques.routeReason: A rect animated by `track` over a plate; the plate itself is footage (a landscape: licensed stock or own shoot). No primitive morphs a full-frame matte into a target element's rect.

techniques.name: Punch-in cut with the background thrown out of focus
techniques.description: Hard cut at F94 from the wide plate to about 1.9x on the icon dock; the plate behind is now strongly defocused while the icons stay sharp and keep sliding left at the same speed across the cut.
techniques.routeReason: Two framings of one stage: `RegionCamera` for the punch and a `DepthLayer` with lens aperture for the defocus, or `snap-zoom` without its blur. The plate is footage.

techniques.name: Tool dock slides until the selection rests on the product's mark
techniques.description: A row of rounded app icons (about 5% of frame width, spaced about 13%) floats over the defocused plate with a white underline under the selected one. The row slides left continuously (about 2.4 s) while the selection passes along it; the last icon is the product mark, ink-black; on arrival the other icons blur (F161-F166) and the mark stays sharp.
techniques.routeReason: Icons on a `track` over a footage plate; the defocus is a per-icon blur driven by the same track. Third-party app icons are not to be reused: draw neutral tool glyphs.

techniques.name: Dark disc sweeps the frame but leaves the mark on top
techniques.description: A soft-edged #0D0D15 disc enters from the lower-left corner and grows past the whole frame in 10 frames (F166-F176), slow-fast-slow (difference 13.8, 15.1, 20.7, 26.3, 30.0, 22.6, 22.8, 20.5, 14.6, 5.9). The mark is drawn above the disc and stays put, turning from a black icon on a light plate into a white-outlined icon on dark.
techniques.routeReason: `shapeWipe` with shape circle and origin at the lower-left corner, the mark rendered outside the TransitionSeries so it stays on top. `shapeWipe` has a hard edge; the soft edge (about 3% of width) is missing.

techniques.description: The mark detaches (F256), tumbles about a quarter turn while rising to (0.5, 0.2) and shrinking to about 4% of frame width (11 frames); the wordmark exits right, accelerating (F261-F266). After a 16-frame hold a circle about 45% of frame width appears around the mark at F283 and opens past the frame by F289 (difference 15, 21, 12.5, 8.7, 5.7, 3.8), revealing the product screen on a pastel ground; the mark is the screen's header at the same position.
techniques.routeReason: `shapeWipe` circle with `fromSize` about 45% of frame width at the mark's position, the mark carried above both scenes (`MatchCut` carry or a persistent layer). The product screen is real UI: capture it with capture:app or rebuild it pixel-faithfully.

techniques.name: Prompt typed in the real field, punch-in to reading size, cursor to send
techniques.description: The prompt types into the product's field (about 6-8 characters per 3 frames at the wide size, unreadable at 2.8% of height). Hard cut at F346 to about 2.6x on the field's right half, cropping it off the left edge so the text is about 7% of frame height; the wide frame blurs one frame before the cut (F345) and the punched frame sharpens over 2 frames. A cursor arrow enters bottom right at F353 and moves to the send button; on the press (F388) the button flips teal #07847C to coral, then a slow pull-out (F390-F396) before the cut to the chat view.
techniques.routeReason: Library block `ui-prompt-bar` types a real prompt field at reference scale; `RegionCamera` for the punch, `Cursor` for the arrow. The interface must be the real product (capture:app or a pixel-faithful rebuild).

techniques.name: Ring of thumbnails orbiting a centred line
techniques.description: Hard cut at F565 to white: about 30 rounded photo thumbnails (each about 7-9% of frame width, soft shadows) on a tilted elliptical ring about 70% wide and 85% high, rotating continuously around a centred line that types word by word (complete by F572). techniques.name: End card: mark settles, wordmark typed in tinted letters, call to action, silent hold
techniques.description: The mark settles to about 7% of frame width by about 26.0 s. From F787 the wordmark types beside it, one letter about every 3 frames, each letter tinted and settling to ink (complete about F818, 27.27 s), the lockup recentring as it grows. At F837-F845 (27.9-28.17 s) a dark #333333 pill button (19% width) and a small grey address fade and rise in under it. Still hold to the end; the sound layer measures silence from 29.33 s.
techniques.routeReason: `scene-end-card` with `wordmarkEntry: "type"` (`sceneEndCardTypedPreset`): the wordmark types a letter every 3 frames beside the mark, each letter in t01's tint run settling to ink through `arrivalTint`, the lockup recentring as it grows; the address is the block's `cta`.

sound.note: Measured silence 29.334-30.187 s: the last 0.83 s of the held end card is silent. What the bed before it is, I cannot hear.
